criticism: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The condition 'require(totalSupply + value <= TOKEN_LIMIT);' is incorrect because if totalSupply overflows, attackers can mint unlimited tokens.

The buyPreSaleTokens function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The factor is a user-controlled variable, and if it is set to a large value, attackers can overflow the buyAmount, allowing them to buy a large amount of tokens for a small amount of ether.
The mint function has an integer overflow, allowing minted tokens to be retrieved arbitrarily by the contract owner.
The function allows the ICO agent to buy tokens for the preSale. The owner of the preSale has an unlimited supply of the DSPX token, and the balance of the preSale is never zero.
